assertions.claim: Alarm sounds or the whole room sickens at once → get everyone outside first, then call.
assertions.cn_span: 一屋子人同时头痛、恶心、发晕，先把人都带到室外，再打电话

assertions.claim: Don't stay inside to find the cause and don't return to close the valve.
assertions.cn_span: 别留在屋里找原因，也别回去关阀门

assertions.claim: Symptoms resemble both a cold and drunkenness; 'better outdoors' is the strongest sign.
assertions.cn_span: 症状像感冒又像喝多了，「出门就好转」是最强的提示

assertions.claim: US: 400+ deaths/year from non-fire unintentional CO poisoning, 100k+ ED visits, 14k+ hospitalizations.
assertions.cn_span: 美国每年 400 多人死于与火灾无关的意外一氧化碳中毒，10 万人以上进急诊、1.4 万人以上住院
